_meta.purpose: Forward simulations give a range, because political events and decisions cannot be predicted. Each outlook multiplies the calibrated year (2025). Written by prep/nfprep/outlook.py from data/monthly_indicators.json.

basis.us: US overnight visitors through the Niagara ports, January-August 2026 against the same months a year earlier: 1.039. Band: 10th-90th percentile of the twelve-month change in 119 ordinary months (0.958-1.092), with the low end set no higher than 2025's political drop (0.873).
basis.domestic: Canadians returning from the US through Niagara, January-August 2026: 1.012 of a year earlier (2025 was 0.689 of 2024). While those trips stay down, the domestic outlook stays at 2025; the low end is some of them returning to US trips.
basis.overseas: The Niagara land ports see few overseas visitors (most land at Toronto Pearson), so the overseas band stays a judgement call.
basis.base_stays: Hotel room nights outside leisure travel. Federal contracts housing asylum seekers ended in 2024-2025; a government decision could add or remove such stays again.
basis.resident: Household spending moves a few percent with jobs and prices.

_meta.seed: Domestic, overseas, base-stay and resident bands are judgement calls: no monthly series measures them for Niagara Falls. Widen or narrow them in prep/nfprep/outlook.py (SEED).
